name: Surah Hud
summary:
Surah Hud – VR Experience

Experience the recitation of Surah Hud, the eleventh chapter of the Holy Quran, in a fully immersive virtual reality environment designed for Meta Quest.

This VR experience provides a peaceful and distraction-free space to listen, reflect, and connect deeply with the teachings of Surah Hud. The immersive virtual environment and high-quality audio make it easy to follow and meditate on the verses.
